scenarios.title: A paste goes viral
scenarios.description: A single paste receives a huge burst of reads.
probes: Where does the load land and what absorbs it?
How is a cache miss storm avoided?

scenarios.title: Illegal content is reported
scenarios.description: Moderators must remove a paste immediately.
probes: How fast does removal propagate through caches?

scenarios.title: Storage backend outage
scenarios.description: The object store becomes unavailable for an hour.
probes: How do writes behave and what is retried?
